title: Nvidia scales back funding guarantee for Ohio OpenAI data center, WSJ reports
summary: Reuters, citing the Wall Street Journal, reported that Nvidia may initially guarantee under $120 billion for the first phase of an SB Energy-developed Ohio project for OpenAI, versus roughly $250 billion previously reported. Reuters said Nvidia did not immediately respond and OpenAI declined comment; no executed guarantee, full lease, permit or power-delivery record was located.

title: KIO Plans US$1.3 Billion Data Center in Queretaro
summary: Mexico Business News reported that KIO Data Centers plans QRO3 at El Marqués Industrial Park in Querétaro, with about $1.3 billion of investment and approximately 100MW of capacity. The outlet quoted KIO's CEO; no standalone company announcement, permit, interconnection, PPA or construction record was located in this run.

title: Naver invests in US offshore wave powered data center company Panthalassa
summary: Data Center Dynamics reported that Naver invested in U.S. offshore wave-powered data-center company Panthalassa. The article body was access-restricted during this run, and no primary announcement, investment amount, ownership stake, site, MW, grid arrangement or construction schedule was located.
